registry_file.description: Path to the Windows NT registry file (e.g., SYSTEM, SOFTWARE) to read.

prefix_filter.description: Registry path prefix to filter output. Only keys/values under this path are printed. Use '/' for no filter.

type_filter.description: Registry value type filter. Options: NONE, SZ, EXPAND_SZ, BINARY, DWORD, DWORD_BE, LINK, MULTI_SZ, RSRC_LIST, RSRC_DESC, RSRC_REQ_LIST, QWORD, KEY.

declare_column_header.description: If true, prints a header row (equivalent to -h). If false, suppresses header (-H).

declare_parent_timestamp.description: If true, printed values inherit the timestamp of their parent key (equivalent to -i).

declare_security_descriptor.description: If true, adds columns for security descriptor info: owner, group, sacl, dacl, class (equivalent to -s). If false, disables it (-S).

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose output (equivalent to -v).
